|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Exsanguinate''' is a [[Physical damage|physical]] [[spell]] that shoots out blood tendrils in a cone that deal physical damage and deal physical [[damage over time]] on hit, which can stack up to three times. Tendrils can be supported by [[chain]] modifiers to hit more enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Casting Exsanguinate costs [[life]] instead of [[mana]]. * Likewise, using {{il|Trap Support}} or {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}} {{il|High-Impact Mine Support}} will also cause them to use [[life]] instead [[mana]]. * Each debuff applied by this skill has its own duration. Applying a second or third instance of the debuff does not refresh the duration of the previous ones. * Tendrils are not [[projectiles]] but they can be affected by chain (e.g. {{il|Chain Support}}). ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical Damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Physical Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Physical Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = Physical
